description: Invite a teammate to this workspace by email with a role-bound 7-day /invite/<token> link (Studio up to 3 seats, Pro up to 15 seats). Sends the invitation email automatically when mail is configured and returns the invite link as well. Ask the user for the exact email and role first.

alsoBrandIds.description: Further brands (ids from brands_list) the same invitation adds the person to, with the same role: one invite for several client brands. Owner only, and only brands of the same owner. A brand with no seat left, or that the person is already in, is left out and named under skipped.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

email.description: Email address of the teammate to invite, up to 200 characters.

role.description: Workspace role for the invited teammate: "admin", "editor" or "viewer". Defaults to "editor".

name: team_invite
title: Invite a team member
